title.narrative: Support for women human rights activists in India

description.narrative: Human rights activists in India are leading community-based actions against violence, shaping inclusive policies and establishing sustainable systems for gender equality, public health and disaster resilience. The project builds on existing partnerships and the project promoters long-standing presence. Cross-sector alliances for long-term change, for example with various government agencies, academic institutions and the media, help to integrate human rights defenders into local systems and improve response mechanisms across sectors.
